rules: Warm ledger paper carries the open human world and unresolved work.
Deep mineral carries accountable records, evidence, and institutional surfaces.
Core oxide marks one active decision or owned path; use the bright value only on mineral.
Perimeter steel marks rented capability, current routes, dependency, and secondary structure.
Sage appears only when the represented state is actually verified.
Risk appears only for a sourced contradiction, failure, or negative exception.

prohibitions: Do not assign a new hue when an existing semantic role already describes the state.
Do not use oxide, sage, or risk as general emphasis or decoration.
Do not revive Rev C gold or Rev D cobalt as competing semantic accents.
